title: Reconciliation items opened and closed through read-time derivation only, so no inbox-item-changed reached the streams as wire contracts section 10 requires
resolution: The card projector compares each projected card's reconciliation items, and on an unrecorded-process touch the installation's, with their last published projection and publishes inbox-item-changed once per change; PostgreSQL tests fail before the fix (fb-15b-p1-1.log).

title: The answer service replayed a held key or refused it as reused before it checked that the item belongs to the requested scope
resolution: The service locates the item in the requested scope before it reads the key; a service test fails before the fix (fb-15b-p1-2.log), and an HTTP replay test after a lost role or scope, red under a mutation that skips the item check (fb-15b-p1-M2-auth.log), follows the coordinator's constraint.

title: The in-memory answer key and reconciliation answer stores returned their held records, so a reader could change a stored outcome or audit record
resolution: Both in-memory stores return a structured copy on every read; a new conformance case in each shared suite changes a read record and expects the next read unchanged, and fails for both in-memory stores before the fix while the PostgreSQL adapters pass it (fb-15b-p1-3.log).

title: A historical execution item took the task's current ownership generation and, when not started, the task's latest change time, so later task changes rewrote it
resolution: The subject names the execution's grant generation, and a not-started execution closes at the time the projector first recorded it closed; a PostgreSQL test that changes the task's time and generation afterwards fails before the fix (fb-15b-p1-1.log).

title: No PostgreSQL test showed that a native answer's consumption rolls back when the outer inbox key record fails
resolution: A PostgreSQL test with the composed native source fails the key record after the native consumption and expects the session, native key, item, audit, events, and inbox keys unchanged, then retries and replays; it fails under the earlier unbound timeline binding (fb-15b-p1-5.log).

title: The product ports ownership table still attributed the reconciliation source to item 44
resolution: The table attributes the source to sub-change 15b of item 15 and leaves item 44 the queue's own surface and re-admission.
